items.title: Teachers in Peshawar protest ‘abrupt layoffs’ by UNHCR
items.description:
PESHAWAR: Hundreds of Pakistani teachers, who provided education to Afghan children in refugee camps for decades, but were laid off without any financial relief, protested here on Tuesday against the ‘abrupt’ layoffs.  

As many as 291 teachers, who have been providing education to Afghan children under the auspices of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) for the past 35 to 40 years, have been laid off without prior notice or any financial relief.

items.title: UN body to review Pakistan’s progress on rights today
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: A United Nations committee will review Pakistan’s efforts to implement the Interna­tional Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR) during its eighth session in Geneva on Wednesday. 

The Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (CESCR) is a body of 18 independent experts that monitors implementation of the ICESCR by its state parties.
